verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is a law firm, but it also ships a software product, Visalaw AI, and a SaaS product could plausibly offer official SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only end-user drafting, research and document workflows, with no SDK, API, or developer documentation. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec (all paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
